主要内容: On January 19, 2016, Arthur G. Caputo, Executive Vice President and President of the Waters Division of Waters Corporation, announced his resignation, effective February 10, 2016. Mr. Caputo is expected to remain a non-executive employee of the company until the end of the year or until an agreed-upon date, at which point he will retire. The resignation is part of the company's corporate governance structure and does not include any financial details or market impact statements. The press release was issued on January 25, 2016, and the report was signed by Eugene G. Cassis, Corporate Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Waters Corporation, on the same date.
